title: English teaching jobs in Ho Chi Minh City: who's hiring (2026)
description: Who was hiring English teachers in Ho Chi Minh City on 22 November 2026: postings by employer type, which ask for native speakers, how to apply, and fees to refuse.
h1: English teaching jobs in Ho Chi Minh City: schools and centres hiring now, and how to apply
intro: On 22 November 2026, the eno.vn jobs board showed 51 teaching postings. 28 were listed under Ho Chi Minh City. 1 of them was in Da Lat and 2 had passed their deadline, so this guide counts 25, mostly from international schools and language centres. A few postings asked only for expats and one preferred native speakers, but most said nothing about nationality in the title. You apply on the original posting, and you never pay anyone to get a job.
keyPoints: According to the [eno.vn jobs board](/c/jobs), on 22 November 2026 there were **51 teaching postings**: 28 listed under Ho Chi Minh City (one of them a VUS job in Da Lat), 22 in Hanoi and 1 in Da Nang. Not all of them are English teaching jobs.

On 22 November 2026, the Hiring now sort of the [school directory](/schools) showed **6 Ho Chi Minh City employers** with open jobs. They were 2 international schools, 2 language centres, 1 university and 1 teacher agency whose only posting on the board had passed its 20 November apply-by date.

This guide counts 25 Ho Chi Minh City postings on 22 November 2026. Of those, 4 asked for expats in the title ("Expat", "Expat Only", "For expat"), 1 said native speakers were preferred, and none asked only for native speakers.
A linked posting leaves eno.vn by its apply-by date. That is the posting's own deadline or 14 days after it was posted, whichever comes first. Check the original posting before you apply.
A real employer never asks for a fee, a deposit or payment for training before you start. eno.vn has not verified the employers behind these jobs.

sections.title: Which schools in Ho Chi Minh City are hiring teachers now?

blocks.text: According to the [eno.vn jobs board](/c/jobs), on 22 November 2026 there were **51 teaching postings**, and 28 of them were listed under Ho Chi Minh City. One of those 28, from VUS The English Center, was for a job in Da Lat. Two more, from Power English and Spark English Center, had passed their deadline: their posting pages on eno.vn showed an apply-by date of 20 November. So of the 28 listed under Ho Chi Minh City, 1 was in Da Lat and 2 had passed their deadline, and this guide counts **25**. The numbers change every day, because linked postings expire and new ones arrive.

blocks.title: A posting on the board may already be closed
blocks.text: A linked posting leaves eno.vn by its apply-by date. That date is the posting's own deadline or 14 days after it was posted, whichever comes first. A posting can also go sooner if the source site removes it. On 22 November 2026, two Ho Chi Minh City postings were still on the board although their posting pages gave an apply-by date of 20 November, and one was shown as a month old, so a posting's presence on the board does not prove it is open. Open the original posting, or ask the poster, to check whether the role is still taking applications.

Few postings show pay. On the jobs board on 22 November 2026, a part-time posting titled "Giáo viên dạy tiếng anh giao tiếp" (conversational English teacher) offered {{vnd:5000000}} a month. It was shown as a month old, so ask the poster whether it is still open. To compare pay across job types, see [English teacher salary in Vietnam](/teach-in-vietnam/english-teacher-salary-in-vietnam).

sections.title: Are international schools in Ho Chi Minh City hiring?

blocks.text: Yes, and many of them were hiring for the year starting in August 2027. On 22 November 2026, Ho Chi Minh City postings on the jobs board included "expressions of interest for August 2027" in secondary English, maths, science and business studies, primary and kindergarten. That is recruitment almost a year in advance.
English roles in international and bilingual schools that the board showed in Ho Chi Minh City on 22 November 2026 are listed below, with names as the postings give them:

items: **MYP English Language Acquisition Teacher (AY2027-2028)**, posted by Inspired Education.
**Secondary Science / ESL Teacher**, posted by Korean International School - HCMC.
**Secondary English Teacher**, an expression of interest for August 2027 with no employer named on the board.
**ESL Teacher immediate hire**, posted by UK Academy (UKA) International Bilingual School, marked "For expat".

blocks.text: On the same day, the 22 Hanoi postings came mostly from international schools. They included English roles posted by Nord Anglia Education, Dwight School Hanoi and The Dewey Schools Vietnam. To see how international school hiring works, read [international school jobs in Vietnam](/teach-in-vietnam/international-school-jobs-in-vietnam). To compare schools with centres and other work, read [types of English teaching jobs in Vietnam](/teach-in-vietnam/types-of-english-teaching-jobs-in-vietnam).

sections.title: Do schools in Vietnam only hire native speakers?

blocks.text: No. On 22 November 2026, **5 of the 25 Ho Chi Minh City postings** counted here said something about who they wanted in the title, and none of them required a native speaker. Four asked for expats, which means foreign teachers and not necessarily native speakers. One said native speakers were preferred. The rest said nothing about nationality on the board, so read the original posting.

blocks.text: Can Vietnamese teachers teach English at a language centre?

Yes. At language centres, the law itself allows Vietnamese teachers. [The regulation issued with Circular 21/2018/TT-BGDĐT](https://luatvietnam.vn/giao-duc/thong-tu-21-2018-tt-bgddt-quy-che-to-chuc-hoat-dong-cua-trung-tam-ngoai-ngu-tin-hoc-166595-d1.html), Article 18, sets separate standards for Vietnamese teachers, native-speaker teachers and other foreign teachers of a language:

items: **Vietnamese teachers**: a college-level foreign-language teaching degree or higher, or a college-level foreign-language degree or higher plus a teaching certificate.
**Native speakers**: a college-level degree or higher and a suitable language-teaching certificate.

**Other foreign teachers**: one of three options. The first is a foreign-language teaching degree. The second is a college-level foreign-language degree plus a suitable teaching certificate. The third is a college-level degree, a language certificate at level 5 or above, and a suitable teaching certificate.

blocks.text: These standards still apply. [Circular 26/2025/TT-BGDĐT](https://luatvietnam.vn/giao-duc/thong-tu-26-2025-tt-bgddt-sua-doi-bo-sung-phan-quyen-giao-duc-dia-phuong-422478-d1.html), issued and in force from 25 December 2025, amended the regulation only by replacing "district People's Committee" with "commune People's Committee" in Article 26(2). It did not change Article 18, according to the text published by LuatVietnam. The centre has the final word on what it asks of you. International and bilingual schools set their own requirements. Foreign teachers also need a work permit. See [requirements to teach English in Vietnam](/teach-in-vietnam/requirements-to-teach-english-in-vietnam) and [the work permit for English teachers](/teach-in-vietnam/vietnam-work-permit-for-english-teachers). If a posting asks for "native" or "expat" and you are neither, read [hiring bias in teaching jobs](/teach-in-vietnam/discrimination-and-hiring-bias-in-teaching-jobs-in-vietnam) before you decide whether to apply.

sections.title: How do I apply for a teaching job in Vietnam on eno.vn?

blocks.text: How you apply depends on the type of posting. On a **linked job**, the Apply button opens the job board's or school's own posting, and your application goes to them, with no eno.vn account needed. A **job posted directly** on eno.vn has no outside posting, so you sign in and message the poster.

items.title: Filter for Ho Chi Minh City
items.text: Open the [jobs board](/c/jobs) or the [jobs page](/jobs-vietnam-expats) and choose Ho Chi Minh City. Read the titles first, because maths, science and interpreter postings are not English teaching roles.

items.title: Open the posting and read the requirements
items.text: Check whether it asks for "native", "expat" or only qualifications. Note how old it is and whether it is linked or posted directly. The full requirements are on the original posting.

items.title: Apply in the right place
items.text: For a linked job, tap Apply and apply on the original posting. eno.vn does not handle applications. For a direct job, sign in and message the poster.

items.title: Check the employer before you send documents
items.text: eno.vn has not verified the employers behind these jobs, linked or direct. Look the employer up in the [school directory](/schools), meet at the workplace, and do not send photos of identity documents until you know the employer is real.

items.title: Prepare for the interview and demo
items.text: Read [CV, interview and demo lesson](/teach-in-vietnam/english-teacher-cv-and-demo-lesson-in-vietnam), then check any offer against [what to check in a teaching contract](/teach-in-vietnam/english-teaching-contracts-in-vietnam).

sections.title: Do you have to pay to get a teaching job in Vietnam?

blocks.text: No. According to the [eno.vn jobs page](/jobs-vietnam-expats), a real employer **never asks for a fee, a deposit or payment for training** before you start. The jobs board also says eno.vn does not handle applications and never charges a fee, and tells readers never to pay to get a job.

blocks.title: Stop at any of these
blocks.text: An employer asks for a placement fee, an application fee, money for course books or a compulsory paid training course before you sign. A self-described agent only messages you and has no address you can visit. You are asked for photos of identity documents before any interview. If any of these happens, send no money and report the listing through the [help centre](/help).

For the common scams and how to spot them, read [teaching job scams in Vietnam](/teach-in-vietnam/teaching-job-scams-in-vietnam). General advice on dealing safely on eno.vn is on the [safety page](/safety).

sections.title: How can schools near me find me?

blocks.text: Create a teacher profile. You start at [teacher.eno.vn](https://teacher.eno.vn) with a short form and finish on eno.vn. A teacher profile on eno.vn costs nothing and is public, so schools and centres can read it and message you. It also shows where you live and where you can teach, which lets schools nearby see that you are within reach.

items: A profile shows your subjects, the ages you have taught, your experience, where you live, where you can teach and your qualifications. You type in your qualifications as information and do not upload documents.
You add an intro video and your CV. The video can be kept private and sent when someone asks for it.
Your phone number, email and CV stay hidden until you tap Share in a chat, and you can withdraw that sharing later.
Each chat shows whether the writer is a verified business, an identity-verified person or not verified. Anyone can send at most two messages until you reply.
For cover work, you mark the periods you are free each week, set an hourly rate and choose the districts you will travel to. You are notified when a school messages you.

blocks.text: Postings and teachers still use the old district names, such as District 1, Binh Thanh or Thu Duc. [Since 1 July 2025 the district level has been dissolved](https://en.baochinhphu.vn/historic-milestone-in-modern-viet-nam-111250701123506887.htm) and official addresses use the new ward names. Ask the employer for the exact address where you will teach. For more on cover work, read [cover lessons in Ho Chi Minh City](/teach-in-vietnam/cover-lessons-and-substitute-teaching-in-ho-chi-minh-city). To see how other people set out their profiles, browse [teachers](/c/teachers).

sections.title: Where else can I find teaching jobs in Vietnam?

blocks.text: Most postings on eno.vn link back to job boards and schools' own careers pages. Follow the careers pages of the employers you want directly. The full list of other channels is in [finding a teaching job in Vietnam](/teach-in-vietnam/finding-a-teaching-job-in-vietnam).

items: **Language centres**: many part-time roles. See [working at a language centre in Ho Chi Minh City](/teach-in-vietnam/language-centre-jobs-in-ho-chi-minh-city).
**International schools**: they recruit early. On 22 November 2026, several postings on eno.vn were already hiring for August 2027.
**Universities**: few postings. On 22 November 2026, the Hiring now sort showed one university in Ho Chi Minh City.
**Tutoring and online work**: see [private tutoring and online teaching](/teach-in-vietnam/private-tutoring-and-online-teaching-in-vietnam).

blocks.text: To see what teachers say about a school, open its page in the [school directory](/schools). On 22 November 2026 the directory listed 172 Ho Chi Minh City employers: 72 language centres, 36 international schools, 28 bilingual schools, 19 universities and 17 teacher agencies. Most have few or no reviews yet.

blocks.title: Hiring a teacher instead?
blocks.text: This page is for people looking for work. Schools and centres can read [Hire a foreign English teacher in Vietnam](/guides/hire-a-foreign-english-teacher-in-vietnam), or the Vietnamese guide [Tuyển giáo viên nước ngoài dạy tiếng Anh](/huong-dan/tuyen-giao-vien-nuoc-ngoai-day-tieng-anh), and browse public profiles under [teachers](/c/teachers).

sections.title: What this guide does not cover

items: **Hiring a teacher as an employer**: see [Hire a foreign English teacher in Vietnam](/guides/hire-a-foreign-english-teacher-in-vietnam).
**Whether a particular vacancy is still open**: only the original posting or the employer can tell you that.
**Teaching jobs in Hanoi or Da Nang in detail**: compare the cities in [Hanoi vs Ho Chi Minh City for teachers](/teach-in-vietnam/hanoi-vs-ho-chi-minh-city-for-teachers).

faqs.q: Which schools are hiring English teachers in Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: On 22 November 2026, the Hiring now sort of the eno.vn school directory showed six Ho Chi Minh City employers with open jobs. They were Scotch AGS and Korean International School HCMC, VUS The English Center and Everest Education, RMIT University Vietnam, and one teacher agency whose only posting had passed its 20 November apply-by date. Postings leave the board by their apply-by date, so check each original posting to see whether the role is still open.

faqs.q: Can non-native speakers get English teaching jobs in Vietnam?
faqs.a: Non-native speakers can get English teaching jobs in Vietnam, depending on the posting. On 22 November 2026, none of the 25 Ho Chi Minh City postings counted in the eno.vn guide asked only for native speakers in its title, and one said native speakers were preferred. Four asked for expats, meaning foreign teachers and not necessarily native speakers. The other postings said nothing about nationality in the title, so read the original posting.

faqs.q: Can Vietnamese teachers teach English at a language centre in Vietnam?
faqs.a: Yes. The regulation issued with Circular 21/2018/TT-BGDĐT lets language centres employ Vietnamese teachers, and Circular 26/2025/TT-BGDĐT did not change those standards. Vietnamese teachers need a college-level foreign-language teaching degree or higher, or a college-level foreign-language degree or higher plus a teaching certificate. Some Ho Chi Minh City postings ask only for expats, so Vietnamese teachers should read each posting and ask the centre before applying.

faqs.q: Do you have to pay to get a teaching job in Vietnam?
faqs.a: No. A real employer in Vietnam never asks a teacher for a fee, a deposit or payment for training before the job starts. eno.vn does not handle applications and never charges a fee to apply. If a school or agent asks for money to secure a job, send nothing and report the listing to eno.vn through its help centre.

faqs.q: How do I apply for teaching jobs on eno.vn?
faqs.a: Applying for a teaching job on eno.vn depends on the posting. On a linked job, the Apply button opens the job board's or school's own posting, and you apply there without an eno.vn account. On a job posted directly on eno.vn, you sign in and message the poster. eno.vn has not verified the employers, so check each employer before you send documents.

faqs.q: Are international schools in Vietnam hiring teachers now?
faqs.a: International schools in Vietnam recruit almost a year ahead. On 22 November 2026, several Ho Chi Minh City postings on eno.vn invited expressions of interest for August 2027 in English, maths, science, business studies, primary and kindergarten. Most of the 22 Hanoi postings on the same day came from international schools. Each original posting gives its own deadline and requirements.

faqs.q: Is a teaching job on eno.vn still open?
faqs.a: To know whether a teaching job on eno.vn is still open, open the original posting. A linked posting leaves eno.vn by its apply-by date. That date is the posting's own deadline or 14 days after it was posted, whichever comes first, and the posting can go sooner if the source removes it. A posting still on the board may already be filled.
